key_idea: k is only 1000, so try every keep as the residence and sum the distances.
sketch: For each candidate keep compute the sum of Euclidean distances to all other keeps with hypot, take the minimum sum and divide by k-1. O(k^2)=1e6 sqrt calls. Print with 9 decimals; double precision is ample. The only trap is dividing by k-1 rather than k.
